text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and your mind. A balanced diet gives you energy and helps you stay strong, so try to eat plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains. Regular exercise, even a short walk every day, keeps your heart healthy and reduces stress. Getting enough sleep is also important, because your body needs rest to recover. Don't forget mental health: talk to friends, take breaks, and share your feelings. Finally, a good work-life balance helps you enjoy your job without forgetting your personal life. Small daily habits can make a big difference.
